description: Primary materials establish 1:1 Naira backing, approved-commercial-bank reserve holdings, regular reserve reporting, current circulation and direct verified-user redemption, but exact reserve-account segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness treatment, current reserve allocation by asset class and all current custodial institutions are not fully established in the reviewed primary sources.
notes: Do not infer statutory trust status, bankruptcy remoteness, current reserve allocation percentages or a complete custodian list from general reserve statements.
